definitions.explanation: Attempting something again after a previous failure or setback. Emphasizes determination and willingness to try once more.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}するつもりだ。
examples.english: I plan to try again next year.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{落|お}ちたが、すぐに{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}を{決意|けつい}した。
examples.english: I failed the exam, but immediately resolved to try again.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}{失敗|しっぱい}しても{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}する{姿勢|しせい}が{大切|たいせつ}だと、コーチに{教|おし}わった。
examples.english: My coach taught me that the attitude of trying again no matter how many times you fail is what matters.

notes:
USAGE:
{再挑戦|さいちょうせん} combines {再|さい} (again) + {挑戦|ちょうせん} (challenge). It has a positive, determined nuance — the speaker is not giving up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再挑戦|さいちょうせん}する (to try again)
- {再挑戦|さいちょうせん}の{機会|きかい} (opportunity to try again)
- {再挑戦|さいちょうせん}を{決意|けつい}する (to resolve to try again)
